title: Wooden Axe
body:
Removed
The following content has been removed from the game or does not exist.

Reason: All Wooden Axes have been replaced with Rusty Axes

"It may be made of wood, but it gets the job done!"

Description

The Wooden Axe was once a starting tool, being now replaced by the Rusty Axe. It is the weakest axe in the game, as well as being one of the smallest in the game, the other one being Steel Axe.

Appearance

Wooden Axe is a small hatchet made entirely out of wood. It's headpiece is colored maroon red, apparently made with the use of an unknown test tree (according to Akkoza), and it's handle is colored oak brown. Entire model is using the legacy Roblox wood material.

Trivia

  • In early pre-release, alongside the wooden axe, you could also buy 3 other starting tools. These being: Wooden Pickaxe, Wooden Saw and a Wooden Chisel. These never saw public release due to being practically useless.
